rationale: R7 forbids an EMPTY edge endpoint, and `script/m14/go-endpoint-defects.ts` found 4 `references` edges with an empty TARGET on go-stdlib (11,788 files through the production parseFile) — every one a compiler-rejection fixture where the pinned grammar produced an ERROR or MISSING node where a type was expected, so the name read off it was empty: syntax/testdata/tparams.go (`func f[ /* ERROR empty type parameter list */ ]()`), internal/types/testdata/check/vardecl.go, internal/types/testdata/examples/functions.go, internal/types/testdata/fixedbugs/issue45635.go. The fix is ONE gate at a choke point rather than four guards at push sites, because each emitter reads a name from a node it believes is well formed and the grammar does not always deliver one — and a guard per site is exactly how the PHASE-3b import guard was bypassed by a raw-string spelling (see go/imports-empty-path). THE EXPECTATIONS CARRY THE SHAPE, because the gate must not be implemented as 'drop the file' or 'stop after the first error': the malformed generic must cost EXACTLY one edge, the well-formed generics either side of it must still emit their `references` and `contains` edges, and a declaration AFTER the malformed one must still be exported and contained. Every row below is authored from a re-probed emission (script/m14/tmp/go-fixture-rels.mts), not predicted.

expectRelationships.comment: AFTER the malformed declaration. Go is not C: a syntax error upstream does not silence a declaration downstream, and a guard that stopped emitting at the first error would drop this row.
the malformed declaration is still a package-scope declaration with an exported name, so the SYMBOL is published even though its unreadable type produced no edge

expectMetadata.comment: exactly the one `references` edge whose type name was unreadable
the control: a VALID file must drop nothing, and a gate that drops rows on good input is indistinguishable from one that is too aggressive

forbidRelationships.comment: R7: the empty endpoint this fixture exists to forbid
R7: an empty SOURCE is the same violation in the other direction
